entities.summary: The ANBO II was a parasol-wing monoplane aircraft built in Lithuania in 1927 as a pilot trainer for the Army. It was the first Lithuanian trainer aircraft of own design. It was eventually re-equipped with more powerful engine for the Aero Club of Lithuania in 1931 before being written off after a crash in 1934.
